name: Smoothstep Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A technique to achieve C1-smooth interpolation in multiresolution hash encodings by applying the smoothstep function to trilinear interpolation weights, avoiding the computational cost of higher-order interpolation while eliminating derivative discontinuities.
summary: Smoothstep Trilinear Interpolation achieves C1-smooth interpolation in multiresolution hash encodings at zero computational cost, unlike standard trilinear methods that suffer from derivative discontinuities.
